provenance.adapters: mock only (MockAdapter and MessageMockAdapter of haia_agent.gopel_v064); no network, no API keys

schema.author: Basil C. Puglisi, MPA
schema.description: Append-only, hash-chained audit trail for multi-AI governance workflows. Seven deterministic operations. Zero cognitive work. Every record is cryptographically linked to its predecessor.

record_types.request: Human task submission: prompt, role, scope, platform selections
record_types.dispatch: API call to each platform: platform ID, prompt hash, status
record_types.response: Complete unedited platform response: text, hash, metadata
record_types.navigation: Navigator synthesis: convergence, divergence, dissent, recommendation
record_types.arbitration: Human checkpoint decision: accept/modify/reject with rationale
record_types.decision: Final authorized output with linkage to all upstream records
record_types.system: Operational events: errors, alerts, configuration changes

schema.chain_mechanism: Each record's chain_hash = SHA-256(content_hash + previous_hash). First record uses 'genesis' as previous_hash. Any modification to any record invalidates all subsequent chain_hash values.
schema.immutability_rule: Append-only. No records may be modified or deleted. Corrections are new records referencing originals.

operating_models.model_1_agent_responsible_ai: Agent runs full pipeline. Human reviews final output at single checkpoint.
operating_models.model_2_agent_ai_governance: Agent pauses after each functional role. Human approves before proceeding.
operating_models.model_3_manual_human_ai_governance: No agent automation. Human orchestrates everything manually. Agent only logs.
